name: Silent Approach
briefing:
## Situation
Daylight, haze. Post Alpha sits in a mountain valley. FPV drones guided over a fibre-optic cable have been reported in this sector: they emit no radio signal and cannot be jammed.
## Mission
Detect, identify and defeat the FPV before it reaches Post Alpha. Leave birds and friendlies alone.

## Intel
Expect a low approach along the valley from the south-east, hidden by the ridges until late. The RF detector will hear nothing from it, and the jammer will not stop it: the interceptor is the answer.
